# clio sync pull

take remote changes from a sync server

## Usage

```
clio sync pull --remote HOST:PORT [--mode push|pull|bidirectional] [--banks a,b] [--token T] [--output json|text]
```

## Description

the key is read from CLIO_SYNC_KEY_FILE when set, otherwise from the store `clio sync keygen` recorded; --token falls back to CLIO_SYNC_TOKEN

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--remote HOST:PORT` | text |  | Names the peer `sync_cli::transfer_args` sends to, as `host:port`; the transfer refuses to run without it. |
| `--mode push\|pull\|bidirectional` | enum: push, pull, bidirectional | `pull` | Selects the operation `sync_cli::transfer_args` sends: `push`, `pull`, or `bidirectional`; absent, the sync tool uses `pull`. |
| `--banks a,b` | text |  | Limits the transfer to the named banks; `sync_cli::banks_arg` splits the comma list and refuses one that names no bank. |
| `--token T` | text |  | Bearer token for the peer `sync_cli::secret_flag` sends; absent, it falls back to `CLIO_SYNC_TOKEN`. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

Take remote changes from a peer.
```
clio sync pull --remote 127.0.0.1:8788
```

Pull one bank.
```
clio sync pull --remote 127.0.0.1:8788 --banks default
```

Print the transfer report as JSON.
```
clio sync pull --remote 127.0.0.1:8788 -o json
```
